opening.argument: The ABC 15 Daybreak branding and Smart Shopper presentation frame this as a consumer segment demonstrating a gift-card auction. The segment explains the cost of participation: viewers must sign up and buy credits, with three credits costing $3 to enter an auction. It also expressly warns that someone who does not win loses those $3. The interface shows a $50 gift card with a low current price and auction controls, placing the advertised discount within a visible bidding process. The low price is presented alongside the entry cost and loss risk, not as an unexplained promise of money.

citations.quote: You sign up and buy credits. You need three credits to join an auction and three credits will cost you three bucks.
And if you don't win, you will be out those $3.
